S031-02.notes: 'only after the community had built...' = a condition. C contradicted; B and D unsupported.

S031-03.notes: Pollen shows an alternative cause, so timing alone doesn't prove human responsibility. B overreaches (pollen doesn't settle cause, and 'timing alone' can't indicate that); C contradicts 'same time'; A unsupported.

S031-04.notes: A park with the same layout/plantings but no trapping history is also avoided -> points to park features, not trapping memory. B supports (social learning of danger); A consistent with fading memory; D supports the hypothesis (similar features don't cause avoidance) -- a plausible trap for students who misread direction.

S031-06.notes: Historian says creatures recorded supposed knowledge more than marking danger. A is Text 1-ish; B contradicts tracing to natural-history books with belief; C is about sailors, not discussed.

S031-07.notes: Goal: advantage + audience unfamiliar, so the sentence must say what a qanat is. B defines it and gives the evaporation advantage. A states the advantage but never explains what a qanat is -- the main trap. C and D give no advantage (gravity alone could be read as an advantage in C, but it's not framed as one).

S031-08.notes: Little SO2 (the cooling agent); instead it released lots of water vapor (warming). Contrast/substitution -> Instead. C 'For this reason' is a lure (little SO2 didn't cause the water vapor). Facts check out: HTHH 2022 released little SO2 (~0.4-0.5 Tg) and ~150 Tg water vapor (~10% boost to stratospheric water); early studies suggested possible temporary warming.

S031-09.notes: List items contain internal commas and later items are separated by semicolons ('Greenland; and'), so 'Reykjavík, Iceland;' is needed. A comma (A) is the common trap; B colon and D no punctuation wrong.

S031-10.notes: Subject 'Sylvia Earle' needs a finite main verb after the nonrestrictive 'who' clause; only 'founded' supplies one. Facts accurate: Earle founded Mission Blue in 2009 (TED Prize); 100+ expeditions, 7,000+ hours underwater.
